moves.name: measured-force
moves.sequence: Two articulated bronze forepaws align and close slowly; fine force lines gather into a steady central glint, then hands relax. Self attack buff without target impact.

moves.name: firm-footing
moves.sequence: Two textured clawed feet plant and grip; angular stone braces lock around soles, resist a lateral gust and relax. Self defence and anchoring buff.

moves.name: iron-blow
moves.sequence: Wrapped iron-grey martial forearm draws back, makes one short precision knuckle punch with compressed pressure halo, then withdraws.

moves.name: dune-break
moves.sequence: A granular sandstone ridge is struck at its base by compressed sand; visible cracks split it at one contact, blocks collapse and grit settles.

moves.name: feather-veil
moves.sequence: Ivory flight feathers overlap around empty user space; displaced feather ghosts and thin air obscure the centre, then separate. Self evasion veil.

moves.name: jetstream-detonation
moves.sequence: A braided air jet compresses into one pressure knot and detonates into a torn membrane; cloud fragments drift away.

moves.name: tailwind-cry
moves.sequence: A feathered throat and beak give a short cry; soft sound rings draw out streamlined feather wisps into a settling tailwind. Self speed buff.
